verdict.rationale: Circle documents an official MCP server that LLMs and AI-assisted IDEs can integrate, and a probe confirms the dedicated docs page at /ai/mcp. Its stated scope is helping agents generate and fix code using Circle's offerings (Wallets, Contracts, CCTP, Gateway); it is not shown executing account or transaction operations. Missing for 10: setup and tool-list detail, evidence that agents can act on Circle resources through MCP, independent or hands-on corroboration.
